name_reason: Already compliant: data_fd2_battle_<descriptor> for a battle-domain global scalar. Descriptor (walk_anim_x_scroll_offset) accurately reflects role (cumulative horizontal walk-step parallax scroll accumulator) and that it is a scalar offset/counter. No Ghidra address residue in the name (the trailing tokens are words, not the 0x53b07 address). Symmetric with sibling data_fd2_battle_walk_anim_y_scroll_rows @ 0x53B0B.
purpose: Cumulative window/sub-pixel X scroll accumulator for the smooth field walk-step slide; horizontal counterpart of data_fd2_battle_walk_anim_y_scroll_rows.
logic_summary: Writers fd2_walk_step_left (seed 6) and fd2_walk_step_right (seed 0) set it at slide start, then add the per-frame window-scroll flag on each of the 6 slide frames (left adds -1 when scrolling else 0; right adds +1 when scrolling else 0) and clear it to 0 at step end, so the static image value is 0. Reader fd2_composite_battle_tile_map @ 0x1204e, only on the extra-wide parallax chapters (0x11/0x15/0x16/0x1B), signed-divides it by 2 and adds the result into the static-background source pointer.
datatype: int (signed, dword/32-bit). Confirmed signed by the reader's SAR/SUB/SAR signed divide-by-2 idiom at 0x12053-0x1205a (MOV EDX,EAX; SAR EDX,0x1f; SUB EAX,EDX; SAR EAX,0x1).
element_semantics: Single scalar: accumulated horizontal scroll offset (in units later signed-/2 to a source-byte offset) carried across the 6 walk-step slide frames; reset to 0 between steps. In practice the writers keep the value in [0,6] across a step, so it is never negative at the read site.
comment_original_issue: Pre-existing src comment was factually wrong: it claimed BOTH fd2_walk_step_left and fd2_walk_step_right seed the value to 6. Decompile + source confirm fd2_walk_step_left seeds 6 (aniwalk.c:148) but fd2_walk_step_right seeds 0 (aniwalk.c:299). It also over-claimed the value 'does take negative values via the left-scroll path'; the left path seeds 6 then adds -1 over 6 frames (6->0), so the value stays in [0,6] and is never negative. The signed-int typing is real (reader uses signed /2) but does not imply negative runtime values.
notes: Reader 0x1204e signed /2 idiom verified by disassembly (0x12053-0x1205a). Sibling Y accumulator data_fd2_battle_walk_anim_y_scroll_rows @ 0x53B0B uses an analogous IDIV /3 signed idiom. Ghidra PLATE comment at 0x53B07 is already accurate and consistent with the refined understanding (it already states left=6/right=0 and [0,6] range), so PLATE left untouched per 'consistent => do not modify'. A redundant Ghidra PRE comment also exists with slightly speculative wording ('fd2_walk_step_right (1 WRITE seen; likely more in mirror set)') but it does not contradict the conclusion, so it was left as-is (out of scope; PLATE is the canonical data-plate field). Only the src comment block was edited via Edit; no logic/type/decl changed.
